facts.text: I am planning to launch a new product feature in June.
I need to create a project timeline.
I was promoted to a senior software engineer position three months ago.
I have been leading a team of five engineers.
I am planning to try out Asana for creating a Gantt chart.
I want to estimate the duration of each task based on my team's velocity.
My team has been delivering features ahead of schedule lately.
I completed a high-priority project two months ahead of time.
Completing the high-priority project led to a significant increase in company revenue.
I will use a combination of methods to estimate the duration of each task.
I have a good understanding of my team's strengths and weaknesses.
I will factor my team's strengths and weaknesses into task duration estimates.
I want to confirm that in Asana I can create a task, set a deadline, and assign it to a team member.
I want to confirm that in Asana I can track progress and dependencies between tasks.
I am thinking of organizing a meeting with my team to discuss the project plan and assign tasks.
I want to include the junior engineer Alex in the meeting.
Alex has been doing well under my guidance.
I think including Alex will be a great opportunity for him to learn more about project planning and collaboration.
I will prepare Alex beforehand for the meeting.
I will encourage Alex to participate actively during the meeting.
I will assign Alex a specific role such as taking notes.
I am deciding whether to discuss the project's goals and objectives with the team during the meeting or separately.
I plan to cover the project's goals and objectives at the beginning of the meeting.
I plan to move on to discussing the project plan and task assignments after covering goals and objectives.
